stories.title: Titans DL Harrell hospitalized after car accident in Tampa
stories.summary: Titans defensive lineman Jaylen Harrell was involved in a serious car accident Friday and remains hospitalized, according to the team.

stories.title: Sources: Michigan expected to start QB Underwood; Marsh not playing after charge
stories.summary: Michigan is returning to QB Bryce Underwood vs. No. 4 UCLA after Tommy Carr had started the past four games, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Mets, CF Ewing agree on 8-year, $95M extension, sources say
stories.summary: The Mets and 22-year-old center fielder A.J. Ewing have agreed to an eight-year, $95 million contract extension, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan.

stories.title: Sources: Struggling Aggies expected to bench Reed, start Hart vs. Sooners
stories.summary: Texas A&M is expected to make a change at quarterback, going with sophomore Brady Hart over Marcel Reed against Oklahoma, sources confirmed to ESPN.

stories.title: Melo calls out Humphrey for Baltimore remark: Back your apology with action
stories.summary: Former NBA star Carmelo Anthony challenged Ravens cornerback Marlon Humphrey to do more than apologize after he said Baltimore was "best at making criminals."
